question: How did NVIDIA's export-control risk factor change between its fiscal 2026 10-K and its 10-Q for the second quarter of fiscal 2027?

content.text:
{"reasoning":"Both NVIDIA filings (10-K FY2026 and 10-Q FY2027-Q2) disclose RiskFactor nodes via DISCLOSES. I match export-control risk factors by title in each filing, pair the earlier with the later through PERSISTS_AS when present, and collect chunks from the DISCLOSES edge chunk_ids, EVIDENCED_BY chunks restricted to each filing, and the PERSISTS_AS chunk_ids. Rows with a persisting link come first.","cypher":"MATCH (:Company {ticker: 'NVDA'})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing)-[d:DISCLOSES]->(rf:RiskFactor)
WHERE f.accession_no IN ['0001045810-26-000021', '0001045810-26-000075'] AND (toLower(rf.title) CONTAINS 'export' OR toLower(rf.title) CONTAINS 'license requirement' OR toLower(rf.title) CONTAINS 'trade restriction')
OPTIONAL MATCH (rf)-[:EVIDENCED_BY]->(c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(f)
WITH f, rf, [cid IN d.chunk_ids WHERE cid STARTS WITH f.accession_no + ':'] AS edge_ids, collect(DISTINCT c.chunk_id) AS node_ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (rf)-[p:PERSISTS_AS]-(other:RiskFactor)
WITH f, rf, edge_ids, node_ids, collect(DISTINCT coalesce(p.chunk_ids, [])) AS pl
WITH f, rf, edge_ids + node_ids AS own_ids, reduce(acc = [], x IN pl | acc + x) AS link_ids
WHERE size(own_ids) > 0
RETURN f.fiscal_period AS filing_period, rf.title AS risk_title, own_ids + link_ids AS chunk_ids
ORDER BY size(link_ids) DESC, size(own_ids) DESC"}
